settings.gameRules:
1. Gather your friends around
2. Choose categories
3. Read the question aloud
4. Anyone who HAS done it drinks!
5. Tap "Next Question" to continue

dialogs.aboutMessage:
A fun party game for groups of friends! Select categories and take turns reading questions. Drink if you HAVE done the thing mentioned in the question.

Version 1.0.0
